purpose: G1-lite (before human labels, before Chuseok): is WHICH evidence the reader gets a bottleneck at all? Same frozen reader, four evidence conditions, silver oracle from SpaceNet 7 labels. Decides whether to spend the 100 human-hours over Chuseok on prefix-visible gold.
reader: frozen TEOChat (existing .venv-teochat, fp16) as a temporal EO VLM baseline reader; no training. RGB monthly mosaics as frames. Reader choice is a limitation: results say 'for this reader', not for readers in general.
episodes: 12 dev AOIs (deterministic pick: sorted AOI names, every 5th), 2 cutoffs per AOI (month 12 and month 20), questions generated from labels_match at the cutoff: (Q1) did new buildings appear in region R between months a and b? (yes/no, balanced), (Q2) in which month did construction in R first become visible? (month index), (Q3) which quadrant/region contains the newest construction? Regions R = 4 quadrants of the AOI tile. Gold from labels (silver): first-appearance month of building ids; NOT prefix-visible-verified.

conditions.full_prefix: all months up to cutoff (<=20 frames)
conditions.change_topk: K=4 frames with largest pixel-difference to previous frame
conditions.privileged_silver: K=4 frames chosen from labels: the month before first appearance, the month of first appearance, and two later clear months (uses gold, NOT deployable; diagnostic only)

budget_note: K=4 is not artificial scarcity for TEOChat (its context handles few frames); we report token counts. If full_prefix cannot be fed (frame limit), we report that limit as a finding.
metrics: Q2 exact-month accuracy and |error| in months
per condition, paired over episodes; bootstrap CI over AOIs

readings.reader_bottleneck: privileged_silver Q1 acc < .65 -> reader cannot read even good evidence; do NOT proceed to human labelling for memory; fix reader alignment first
readings.no_headroom: privileged_silver - max(latest_k, change_topk) < .05 on Q1 and Q2 -> selection has little headroom; stop the selector claim
readings.headroom_present: privileged_silver beats latest_k and change_topk by >= .10 on Q2 (month) or Q3 (region) with CI excluding 0, AND full_prefix <= privileged_silver -> evidence selection is a bottleneck; proceed to human gold over Chuseok
readings.full_prefix_wins: full_prefix >= privileged_silver -> at 20 frames memory is not needed; the S2 long series (100+ obs) becomes the primary data or the paper is withdrawn

not_allowed: changing K or questions after seeing results; treating silver oracle as human gold; using post-cutoff frames in any deployable condition
compute: GPU1, TEOChat fp16, ~12 AOI x 2 cutoffs x 3 Q x 4 conditions = 288 generations; < 1 GPU-hour
